method: Retrospective comparison of variant sets. K counts selected sets. Each selected set reveals every member's saved lab label. The simulated total resolved includes those directly revealed samples and unrevealed samples counted by the proxy.
interpretation: The strategies compare equal numbers of variant sets. Those sets contain different numbers of samples.
caveats: The comparison uses unequal numbers of sample labels at the same K. Unrevealed samples counted as resolved include cases the proxy can already count using firm-case evidence alone. These totals cannot establish gains at an equal lab testing budget or production catalogue performance.
supports: Descriptive archive simulation. The resolution proxy does not amend the catalogue.
